The ground is tusker-barracks (D54), not the den (black-spawn-den-aluvian: 192 placed 1629 in the landblocks 0x0103-0x0105, SELECT count by landblock_instance) and not the Temple 40+ (0x5C4A, 49 placed: no profile of its own): the Barracks is the ladder's own rung for the level 40 band (entry MinLevel 40, profile level_band 80), its profile lists 1629 and 22593, and the same fight yields the Tusker Guard Tusk for Brighteyes (tusk-guard.json); the den is the home from level 100 (spec section 5.6), and the same task there is another file with another ground
The task is 500 kills over many fights: the kill step is open-ended and the counter (the quest row's solves) survives a run that ends early

M6 14 guard task (the owner, 2026-11-13): the level up job runs this file when --autopilot-ladder-quests names it (tusks,tusker-guard-kill-task; climb.ps1 -Quests), as LadderKillTask: the talk of steps 0-1 is an errand from home while the counter is unread and the timer allows (his reply reads the counter: the start arms it at 0, his DirectBroadcast 'You've killed N out of 500 Tusker Guards.' is his count, a done reply means it was complete and the talk was the turn-in, his wait reply means the timer runs); the kill step is the ladder's own hunt on tusker-barracks in place of her rung's ground while the server's counter is armed (every 'You have killed N Tusker Guards!' line is read); steps 3-4 are the turn-in from where the complete line found her; the station's done check records the 72,000 s timer
